description: This file contains extension methods for the ISiloBuilder and IServiceCollection interfaces to configure in-memory, non-persistent reminder storage within an Orleans silo. It defines methods to add in-memory reminder services for development and testing scenarios, including registering the InMemoryReminderTable as a singleton service.

classes.name: SiloBuilderReminderMemoryExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for configuring in-memory reminder services in Orleans silos.

methods.name: UseInMemoryReminderService
methods.description: Configures the silo builder to use an in-memory, non-persistent reminder store for development/testing environments.

methods.name: UseInMemoryReminderService
methods.description: Configures the service collection to use an in-memory, non-persistent reminder store, registering necessary singleton services.
